title: DataMend evidence payload, version 1
description: The evidence behind ONE fired check on ONE row of a validation run. Read-only. Every number carries a basis: measured (read from the input), assumed (for example a unit taken on trust, or a design-choice threshold) or derived (computed by the platform from measured values). Additive changes only within v1; a breaking change becomes v2 and both are served during a transition.

synthetic.description: true when the uploader declared the data synthetic

time.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp, or the rain day (date it ends) for the daily profile

rule_score.description: uncalibrated fixed-weight ordering of suspicion, never a probability

kind.description: fault -> SUSPECT, uncertain -> UNCERTAIN, info -> no verdict change

time_basis.description: received = the time this platform received a live reading; gap and neighbour comparisons are weaker

window.description: the readings or days looked at, at most the last 24 readings or 14 days

limitations.description: additive in v1 (2026-11-20): fixed sentences on what must not be over-read in this evidence; chosen by facts of the run, never by a model

not_run.description: additive in v1 (2026-11-20): checks of the run that did not run for this station, each as 'check: reason'

provider.description: ONLY present when a trained model scored the row; never produced by the rule-based baseline and never invented. Additive in v1 (2026-11-20): a label-fusion model scored on the server (label_tier reviewer_labels, with score and flagged), or an exported STNet score file (label_tier synthetic, with fault_scores).

score.description: the model's own number, uncalibrated; never a probability of a fault

flagged.description: score reached the threshold fixed on the training data's clean days

fault_scores.description: per fault kind: spike, stuck, scale, phantom_rain, zeroed, drift

ensemble_disagreement.description: only when the provider has one; STNet does not

truncated.description: true when the payload was cut to stay under 64 KB

next.description: path that returns the full row record when truncated
